release_notes: Feature release: the panel gets a themed boot screen that paints before the bundle parses, two new themes (terminal and aurora), a redesigned two-column login with the animated CLICK-CLOAK-OFFER flow diagram, and themed dialogs instead of native browser popups. The Telegram bot becomes a visual menu: a pinned keyboard with readable buttons in seven languages, a localized slash-command list, inline language and campaign pickers, toggle buttons for notifications; conversion pushes and the daily summary speak all seven languages, and the daily summary actually sends now. Cloak diagnostics gained a selectable window with timezone, Campaigns metric headers carry status colour dots, Profitability is renamed to Margin (profit over revenue), the update check no longer holds the panel, bot-IP entries keep their origin across Clear All (migration 50), and a Snapchat Ads source template arrives with its two silent-failure traps handled.
